quotes.text: Viva connections is an employee experience app that lives inside Microsoft Teams. And you can think of it as a digital front door. One place where employees go for company news, tools, and resources.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Compact definition of what Viva Connections is and where it lives.

quotes.text: Viva Connections was always powered by SharePoint. The news, the dashboard, the resources, all of it came from a SharePoint home site behind the scenes
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why the rename to the SharePoint app makes sense.

quotes.text: After a week, engagement on any piece of content drops off a cliff. People don't scroll back through old news. They look at what's fresh, so if you're running Viva Connections, you need to keep the feed active.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Practical lesson that content freshness drives the usage habit.

quotes.text: Organizations that pin the Viva Connections app globally in Teams see 75% of their weekly active usage come from that single action.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Highlights the single most effective low-effort adoption lever.

quotes.text: A sparse dashboard tells employees there's nothing useful here. A rich one tells them this is where work happens.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable argument for building a dashboard with many useful cards.

chapters.title: Who needs it and first steps

takeaways: Viva Connections is an employee experience front door inside Teams, built on a SharePoint home site, with a news reader, a dashboard of cards and curated resources.
In 2026 Microsoft renamed the Viva Connections app in Teams to the SharePoint app, while functionality and admin tools stayed the same and the basic version remains included in Microsoft 365.
Adoption depends on pinning the app globally in Teams, keeping news fresh with multiple posts per week and offering a rich dashboard, especially for mobile and frontline workers.
hook: Static intranets are a ghost town, and many employees never find the news, tools and policies they need. This episode explains Viva Connections and its 2026 rename to SharePoint for intranet owners, internal communicators and Microsoft 365 admins. You learn its three components, the engagement stats that matter and the first steps to make it work.
